name: MeepleMatch
description: Board game discovery with swipe-based voting. Swipe through curated games, get personalized recommendations, buy on Amazon.

name: Black Diamond Alpine Wash
description: Exterior cleaning company site with service pages, quote request form, and local SEO.

name: Benchmark
description: Turn any achievement into a bench press max. A memeable, shareable universal achievement-to-bench-press translator powered by AI.

name: RepMatch
description: Workout rep equivalence calculator. Input your max, roll a random rep count, and compete with friends at equal effort.

name: Crypto Tax 2025
description: Personal 2025 crypto tax reconstruction. Wallet-first imports, deterministic FIFO, audit-ready exports for TurboTax. Single-user, auth-gated.

name: PyroGuard
description: All-in-one operations platform for fire/life-safety inspection contractors — a SedonaOffice replacement in ground-up rebuild. Play 'A Day in the Field': one real NFPA 25 inspection riser-to-invoice, with offline photo capture in a dead zone.

name: Daily
description: An opt-in calendar. Sign in with Google, sync your real Calendar, track interviews + opportunities in a pipeline, and toggle what the world sees on your /u/[username] profile.

name: MacroMarket
description: Ranks 187 foods, snacks, and supplements by dollars per gram of protein. Includes a protein-goal calculator, a deals tab, and a Claude-powered protein coach that recommends the cheapest picks.

name: Health Recap
description: A year-over-year recap of a personal Apple Health export — steps, calories, workouts, and personal records compared across years. Benchmark banner (peak year vs now), per-year annual recaps, all-time records, best day/week/month breakdowns, and activity mix.

name: Varscout
description: A funding-carry screener for Variational Omni. Ranks 540+ perpetual markets by carry net of the round-trip spread you'd actually pay at your size, using the venue's own tiered depth quotes, and collects its own funding history because the upstream endpoint publishes none.
